name: io.github.lzinga/us-gov-open-data-mcp
title: U.S. Government Open Data
description: Open data from 40+ U.S. government APIs: economy, spending, Congress, health, energy, disasters

environmentVariables.name: DATA_GOV_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: api.data.gov key, shared by Congress, FEC, GovInfo, FBI, NREL, Regulations.gov, College Scorecard, USDA FoodData, openFDA and USGS Water

environmentVariables.name: FRED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) API key

environmentVariables.name: CENSUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Census Bureau API key

environmentVariables.name: BLS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bureau of Labor Statistics API key (optional; raises rate limits)

environmentVariables.name: BEA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bureau of Economic Analysis API key

environmentVariables.name: EIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Energy Information Administration API key

environmentVariables.name: NOAA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: NOAA Climate Data Online token (station climate data works without it)

environmentVariables.name: USDA_NASS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: USDA NASS Quick Stats API key

environmentVariables.name: HUD_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: HUD User API token

environmentVariables.name: DOL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Department of Labor API key

environmentVariables.name: USPTO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: USPTO Open Data Portal API key

environmentVariables.name: LDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Senate Lobbying Disclosure (lda.gov) API key (optional; raises rate limits)

environmentVariables.name: AQS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EPA Air Quality System API key (used with AQS_EMAIL)

environmentVariables.name: AQS_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email address registered for the EPA AQS API key

environmentVariables.name: SEC_CONTACT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Your email for the SEC User-Agent; SEC asks automated tools for a contact and may block requests without one

environmentVariables.name: NWS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: User-Agent for the National Weather Service API, with your contact details (a default is sent otherwise)

environmentVariables.name: MODULES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated modules to load (default: all), e.g. 'fred,bls,treasury'

environmentVariables.name: DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domains to load, e.g. 'economy,health' (added to MODULES)

environmentVariables.name: HIDE_UNCONFIGURED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip modules whose required API key is not set

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: 'full' (every tool) or 'discovery' (find_tools and call_tool only)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest tool result in bytes before rows are trimmed (default 150000)
